_comment: Kojo template `interaction` (Docs/TextAuthoring/Plan_KojoTemplates.md §7). Bound to an entry by its `template` field. Every branch is optional except the fallback, the entry's last top-level branch, which must pass for anyone in any state. Axes are listed in nesting / first-match order: a branch is recognised by the fields it sets (kind), siblings must keep this order, anything not matching an axis is free customization. Every branch a writer opens needs its own lines (they print when no child passes). Edit freely, then Update store.
label: 通用互动
_comment_bind: Entries proposed for this template (T7): own entries whose key starts with one of these, without a template field yet.
_comment_bindCommand: Command kojo keys (a command's kojo key + suffix) proposed for this template: the joiner's own lines.
_comment_fallback: The mandatory last branch: these requirement fields, nothing else (role / master / strong flags off, no keepLooking). Engine defaults are not unconditional - requireSelfAction / requireTargetAction / requireEPSuccess default true, allowRecording false. A missing fallback gets a skeleton with the placeholder line.
_comment_axes: kind: selfStatus (selfTags from `tags`), targetStatus (targetTags from `tags`), target (targetBaseID, or targetTags from `tags`), consent (requireSelfForced / requirePermission), relationship (requireRelationshipTypes; legacy targetTags relationship_*), attitude (requireSelfAttitudeGTE / requireSelfAttitudeKey). examples: suggested branches for the docs - other values of the same fields count as the same axis.

axes._comment_alias: aliasSelfTags: lookup-specific self tags that mean this axis - recognised, never rewritten. firstexp_unaware = the speaker is time-stopped, asleep or unconscious (BodyInternal_Instance.GetUnawareReason).

axes.label: 对方是谁
axes._comment_tags: Target tags that say who the target is: InteractionGenderType values, `pov` (the player) and the actor keywords the loaded masterlist defines (race types, template keywords). targetBaseID always counts. Other target tags (body parts in first experience: mouth, penis …) are customization. Add mod keywords here.

axes.label: 同意
axes._comment_alias: firstexp_consent / firstexp_nonconsent come from the same hasPermission (EvaluationPackage.GetFirstExperienceKojo).

_comment_extras: Extras: custom variants with pre-written conditions, enabled per entry by its `templateExtras` list. Copy `requirement` exactly - children don't inherit their parent's fields, so the block carries the loosened defaults the lookup needs. Recognised by the tags in the block; a recognised branch must have exactly this requirement, must be enabled on the entry, and must sit inside an axis branch or the fallback (never top level). Optional: an enabled extra that isn't written is listed as available, not an error. No axis fields here. First experience: the partner part's tags (EvaluationPackage.GetFirstExperienceKojo → the source BodyInternal part's Base.tags); a tongue acts through the mouth part (no tongue part exists).

_comment_relationshipGroups: Suggested relationship branches (requireRelationshipTypes lists). Any set of types is a valid relationship branch - edit or add groups freely. `<type>:A` / `<type>:B` = the speaker is that side of a one-sided type (Character_Relationship.HasRelationshipType); a plain type = either side.
